Personal AI performance and longevity coach.

Aion requires a subscription. It includes a 1-month free trial, then renews monthly.

Disclaimer: Aion provides AI-generated estimations of biomarkers, daily actions, supplement suggestions, trends and strategies for informational and educational purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making any changes to your medication, supplements or lifestyle based on information from this app.
